bioEn: Julien Roux is a french cinematographer based in Paris.
He started his professional career as an camera assistant, working with several cinematographers such as Pierre Cottereau, Alexis Kavyrchine, Arnaud Potier, Vincent Mathias or Pierre Aïm.
At the same time he did the photography of a lot of short films, including "L'accordeur" which won the Cesar of Best Short film in 2012 and for which he earned the Lutin prize of best cinematography.
His various professional background allows him to be totally adaptable to any project: feature films, tv drama or commercials.
